lines.text: The LORD says Moab will be made drunk and become a laughingstock, and its people must settle among the rocks.
The LORD will wail for Moab, and the destroyer falls on its harvest, and the waters of Jordan have dried up.
Every head is shaved and every waist wears sackcloth, because the LORD has shattered Moab like an unwanted jar.
A raven swoops down against Moab, Kirioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized.
Moab's sons are taken into exile, yet in the latter days the LORD will restore Moab from captivity.
